description:
Builds a .lazy file from a spec (see get_guide) and checks it. When ok is true it returns a
        download link for the user (on a hosted server) or saves it as save_as (on a local server);
        include_file also returns the whole file. Otherwise it returns the errors to fix.
        Example: create_graph(spec={"name": "Sine", "nodes": [{"id": "wave", "type": "FormulaGeneratorNode"}, {"id": "plot", "type": "PlotNode"}], "links": [{"from": "wave.out", "to": "plot.in"}]}).

include_file.description: Also return the whole .lazy file in the answer.
include_file.title: Include File

save_as.description: File name for the graph; on a local server it is saved under this name.
save_as.title: Save As

spec.description: The graph spec: name, nodes, links, and optionally notes, dashboard and style (see get_guide).
spec.title: Spec

name: create_graph
title: Create a graph
